notes.title: New Character "Pumpkin Knight"! The Halloween Patch is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]The Halloween Patch is here![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37587014/72ea938fa0beec764a1f3f5cac83b95bf474b753.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added Pumpkin Knight
[*] Game now skips intro settings if already finish Chapter 1.

notes.title: Good Knight Anniversary Patch!
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you everyone for being with us![/h1]
We will be celebrating Good Knight's one year of early access.
Many has said Good Knight has been more complete than most early access out there and we are planning to give everyone more!

[h3]Good Knight Anniversary Patch | New Difficulty Comparison[/h3]
[previewyoutube=GMh3__Okb7A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[h3](Right) High Level gameplay by Top Player Dwaffle[/h3]

[h1]Anniversary Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]120+ FPS!
[*]Hundreds of New Life Advices / Death Insults!
[*]New setting to filter out offensive words!
[*]New Maps!
[*]New Difficulties, Pain Kink (Easy), and Hell (Original Mode)
[*]Reset!
[*]Bug fixes!
[*]Optimizations!
[*]Leaderboard reset!
[*]Improved Graphics!
[*]Improved Gameplay and controls!
[*]and many more!
[/list]
[h2]Thank you so much FGC, Philippine, Vtuber, Streamers, and of course the Good Knight community![/h2]

notes.title: Minor Hotfix Manika Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Good Knight players!
Just dropping a minor patch for now! Named after Manika the PHVtuber who help spot the problem.

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added more bug fixes 
[*] Added more polishes
[*] Preinstalled Highscore starting offline will still have leaderboards. Unlike before going online is needed to get a populated leaderboard.
[/list]
[i]- Developer AlexEValdez[/i]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix Patch - The Kroenyx Patch - Congrats on reaching 3rd place!
notes.notes:
[b]Change Log[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a lot of Leaderboard bugs
[*] Fixed title screen input bugs
[*] Fixed ingame interface bugs
[*] Fixed shooting bug being unlimited
[*] Added GK Maker autosave feature
[/list]
[b]Addressed the following feedback given by Stevie Wonder and Larasana[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed major bug of map preview plays as the actual map on Chapter 1 when coming from GK Maker
[*] Reworded charge message blink to make charge system easier to understand
[/list]
As a tribute to the community, we named this patch the Kroenyx patch to celebrate the milestone of being 4th person to break 500k and now the [b]3rd Rank[/b] on Chapter 1.
